nodes.speaker: Galen
nodes.text: Hmm? Visitors are rare in these woods. The trees have been restless lately... whispering about something stirring in the deep caverns below.

choices.label: Why do you live out here?

nodes.speaker: Galen
nodes.text: Crystal golems guard the deepest chambers. Ancient creatures of living stone and gemstone. They say a great crystal heart pulses at the very bottom... if you can survive the journey.

nodes.speaker: Galen
nodes.text: Enter the Dark Cavern south of Thornvale. On the lowest floor, look for a passage leading deeper. But be prepared — the enemies down there are far stronger than surface goblins.

nodes.speaker: Galen
nodes.text: I was an adventurer once, long ago. These old bones don't move like they used to. The forest keeps me company. The treants are gentle... unless you threaten their grove.

nodes.speaker: Galen
nodes.text: Ancient tree spirits. Slow, but incredibly tough. Their bark is like armor. If you must fight them, use fire or magic — physical blades barely scratch them. They sometimes carry enchanted trinkets from ages past.

nodes.speaker: Galen
nodes.text: Keep your equipment upgraded and your potions stocked. Watch the time of day — the forest wolves hunt at dusk and night. And always check your party's status effects after battle. Poison is a silent killer.

nodes.speaker: Galen
nodes.text: Safe travels, young one. May the forest guide your path.
